title: DiggingSettings
description: A1578 (B4b K5, R33, D711 section 6): digging into the island's underground (map layer: soil, groundwater depth, ore). Each dig where an inhabitant stands deepens the hole of that map cell by step_cm and brings up the material of the layer at that depth as a thing; the first dig makes the pit, reaching the groundwater makes it a well and nothing goes deeper. Ore only above the groundwater, by the cell's ore share. Limited: the height map does not change (that is A1460). Placeholder values for the TL.

action.description: The action that digs (vocabulary action, target none).

step_cm.description: How much deeper one dig goes.

pit_type.description: Object type of the hole (made by the first dig at a cell).

well_type.description: Object type the hole becomes at the groundwater.

tool_property.description: A held thing with this TRUE property digs any layer; with bare hands only layers marked by_hand (no_tool otherwise).

layers.description: Top down: the first whose until_cm lies below the depth dug so far gives the material.

until_cm.description: The layer reaches down to this depth.

material.description: Object type it brings up; null = nothing.

by_soil.description: The cell's soil (map soil ids) decides the material instead, where listed (the top layer is the soil).

by_hand.description: Bare hands can dig it (loose soil). Omitted = only with a tool.

ore_possible.description: Ore can come from this layer (by the cell's ore share).

not_by_hand_on.description: Review GW4 #506: soils of this layer bare hands cannot dig even if by_hand (rock is rock); omitted = none.
